title: On-Demand Pay Report
description: Earned wage access: adoption, draws, amounts and instant transfers.

generation.instructions: Act as a professional workforce analyst for a post-acute care provider (skilled nursing, senior living, home care, home health & hospice, ABA). This report covers On-Demand Pay. Write short messages, max 255 characters. Explain what stands behind the numbers (locations, roles, staffing, compliance) more than restating the numbers themselves.

children.markdown: Earned wage access: adoption, draws, amounts and instant transfers.

Usage growing after launch shows staff value faster access to earned pay.

**Ask:** does On-Demand Pay help retention in high-turnover roles?
Draw amounts by role and requests by weekday.

Hourly direct care staff are the heaviest users.

Requests peak before the weekend.

**Ask:** is it promoted in recruiting?
Instant vs next-day transfers and usage per location.

Instant transfers carry a fee - a high share means urgent needs.

**Ask:** which locations have low adoption?
